methodology: All 19 bladder-reconstruction MDX pages, including the atlas, were read in full and substantively reviewed. Consequential operative claims, current EAU/AUA guidance, comparative evidence, denominators and source identity were checked with full text where accessible and original abstracts otherwise. Corrected known errors and reconciled companion pages; no page is represented as clinical clearance of every claim. Frozen DOI-title/PMID-title signal reports contained no additional 04b entries. Manual source checks found substantive errors regardless of metadata.
